title: Galactic Problem Solver – NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026
summary: Built Marswalk Budget, a Mars walking-route planner, with a team of four at NASA's international hackathon.
details: Took part in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge, an international hackathon led by NASA, on November 14–15, 2026.

Built Marswalk Budget with a team of four for the “Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map” challenge: a planner that weighs science stops on real Mars terrain against suit oxygen, radiation dose and the walk back.
Received the Galactic Problem Solver certificate for outstanding participation and efforts to address challenges we face on Earth and in space.

title: 1st Place – GDG Polytechnique Hackathon
summary: Won first place with my team at the “Browser in the Age of AI” hackathon.
details: Won first place with my team at the hackathon “Le navigateur à l'ère de l'intelligence artificielle” (The Browser in the Age of Artificial Intelligence), hosted by Google Developer Group Polytechnique Montréal at Google's Montréal offices on November 11, 2026.
Our winning project, Silver Sun Scan, helps people spot online scams by checking links, QR codes, suspicious messages and passwords (team TroisPandasUnOursPolaire).
Recognized for the excellence, innovation and creativity of our project.

title: Web Developer
organization: CREII – Centre de référence des élèves issus de l'immigration
summary: Designed and built the CREII website from the ground up with Angular and WordPress.
details: Independently designed and developed the organization's website using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS and WordPress.
Built the website from the ground up, implementing responsive, multilingual interfaces and reusable components.
Integrated Angular with WordPress through custom REST APIs to connect the frontend with website content and services.
Developed a Google Drive-based photo gallery and integrated it into the website.
Integrated and configured services including WooCommerce, Stripe, Brevo and IONOS.
Troubleshot and resolved hosting, DNS, SSL, domain, API and WordPress configuration issues.

Created an engaging and supportive environment while delivering Fusion Jeunesse programs, encouraging teamwork and innovation.
